praesidium-shield-flavor.Text: An auric bulwark bearing the twin eagle, raised between the Emperor's servants and annihilation.

praesidium-bastion-effect-desc.Text: All incoming damage is nullified while the unit remains within the Praesidium Shield's protective field.

praesidium-null-mute-desc.Text: Psychic Power abilities cannot be used while this unit remains within the Praesidium Shield's null zone. Weapon, item and Navigator abilities remain available.

castellan-axe-flavor.Text: A master-crafted polearm combining a power axe with an integrated bolt weapon.

castellan-axe-v1-desc.Text:
A master-crafted Custodes hybrid weapon.

• Levels: 1-15
• Strike: 14–20 damage, 25% armour penetration
• Castellan Onslaught: 2 separately resolved 9–13 hits
• Castellan Sweep: 11–15 damage in a compact 3-cell arc
• Executioner Bolt: precise long-range shot, no ammunition, 2-round cooldown
• Haft Strike: low-damage 1 AP attack that pushes the target 1 cell and can stun for 1 round

castellan-onslaught-v1-desc.Text: Strike the same target 2 times. Each hit deals 9–13 damage with 20% armour penetration and is resolved separately.

castellan-sweep-v1-desc.Text: Make a compact 3-cell sweeping attack, dealing 11–15 damage with 15% armour penetration.

castellan-executioner-bolt-v1-desc.Text: Fire one carefully aimed bolt at 150% of the weapon's normal effective range with +10% hit chance. This attack uses no ammunition. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

castellan-haft-strike-v1-desc.Text: Strike with the weapon's haft for 7–10 damage and push the target 1 cell. On a failed Toughness resistance test, the target is stunned for 1 round. Cost: 1 AP.
